blog_summary: Adrian Colyer highlights this paper as a comprehensive survey of evolutionary computation (EC) algorithms applied to cloud resource scheduling, an NP-hard optimization problem. The blog emphasizes the intractability of deterministic approaches for large-scale scheduling and praises the paper for cataloging a vast body of work using nature-inspired algorithms like Genetic Algorithms (GA), Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), and Ant Colony Optimization (ACO). Colyer notes that EC algorithms offer better scalability and linear time complexity compared to traditional methods like Integer Programming, making them more suitable for cloud-scale problems. The post also underscores the paper's role as a 'jumping off point' for further research, given its structured categorization of existing approaches and emerging challenges in the field.
paper_title: Cloud Computing Resource Scheduling and a Survey of its Evolutionary Approaches
